name: FAMOUS CHOLLIMA (October 2026 DOJ disruption label)

attribution.legal_posture: CrowdStrike and the DOJ N.D. Texas release use FAMOUS CHOLLIMA as a label for the broader DPRK IT-worker and helper network. The label covers the wider network; individual defendants may be different operators, and conviction status is a separate legal matter.

caveats: A campaign label describes a group; shared aliases or methods alone leave records separate.
identity_boundary: Source-reported adversary label for the October 2026 disruption; keep separate from named workers and facilitators absent an explicit source link.

sources.support: The DOJ release says CrowdStrike identified the group as Famous Chollima.
sources.locator: Operation Lonestar Roundup release, FAMOUS CHOLLIMA paragraph

sources.support: CrowdStrike describes the FBI-assisted disruption of FAMOUS CHOLLIMA laptop farms.

sources.quote: U.S. cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike has identified this group of DPRK IT workers and their helpers as “Famous Chollima,” a name that many victims now use to describe the broader threat network.
